dialogue_texts: Oh dear. Manipulating the boundary of 'forward' and 'backward' with such crude amulets...
Whoever manufactured this has rather pedestrian taste.
It's a spatial-inversion charm, but the lingering spiritual pressure is highly concentrated.
The master of this boundary is waiting just ahead.
Calling my craft 'pedestrian' while trespassing in my domain?
My, so the architect finally shows herself.
Tell me, little mirror-weaver, why are you tangling the threads of this manor's timeline?
It's making the night terribly tedious.
Tedious? Tonight, the parallel flows and architectural axes dance to my tune.
Let us see if you can maintain your smug composure when the boundary between 'inside' and 'outside' ceases to exist!
